motions.item_title: Approve the Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting Minutes from October 21, 2025. Board Member Wood…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve the Redevelopment Agency Board Meeting Minutes from October 21, 2025. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: October 21 minutes approved
motions.summary: The board signed off on the written record of its October 21, 2025 meeting.
motions.impact: Housekeeping that makes the last meeting's record official. It touches the clerk's office and nobody else.

motions.item_title: Adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Offi…
motions.motion: Board Member Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Official Project Area Plan for the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Area Project Area. Board Member Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Plan adopted for the Sweetwater #4 project area
motions.summary: The board adopted the official plan for the Sweetwater #4 community reinvestment project area, the document setting out what the agency intends to do there.
motions.impact: Adopting a plan builds nothing on its own and asks nothing of you today. It is the agency's statement of intent for that area, and worth reading if you own land nearby.

motions.item_title: Adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Offi…
motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Official Project Area Budget for the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Area Project Area. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Budget for the Sweetwater #4 project area
motions.summary: The board took up the official budget for the Sweetwater #4 project area, and the minutes do not record how the vote finished.
motions.impact: Without a recorded result, this one is unfinished business. It covers the money side of the project area, so a later meeting is where the outcome will show up.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Eagle Mountain City, Utah for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area
motions.motion: Board Member Wright moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Eagle Mountain City, Utah for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: City sends its Sweetwater #4 tax growth to agency
motions.summary: Eagle Mountain City itself will send its property tax growth from the Sweetwater #4 area to the agency, in an agreement the board approved.
motions.impact: The city and the agency are separate legal entities, so the city has to sign to hand over its own increment. Homeowners see nothing different on a bill.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Utah County for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Utah County for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Utah County agrees to Sweetwater #4 tax split
motions.summary: The board signed the county into the arrangement too: property tax growth Utah County collects inside Sweetwater #4 goes to the agency.
motions.impact: Property tax the county collects inside the project area funds work in that area. If you live elsewhere in the city, this one passes you by.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Central Utah Water Conservancy District for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area
motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Central Utah Water Conservancy District for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Water district to route Sweetwater #4 tax growth
motions.summary: Central Utah Water Conservancy District will hand its share of that same property tax growth to the agency, an agreement the board put in place.
motions.impact: Each taxing entity has to sign separately before the agency can use the money, and this is one of those signatures. You will not notice it anywhere.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Unified Fire Service Area (UFSA) for the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency Minutes – November 5, 2025 Page 4 of 5 Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area
motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to adopt a Resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving an Interlocal Cooperation Agreement between the Eagle Mountain Redevelopment Agency and Unified Fire Service Area (UFSA) for the Collection and Remittance of Incremental Property Taxes Collected from Property Within the Sweetwater #4 Community Reinvestment Project Area. Board Member Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Fire district signs on to Sweetwater #4 tax deal
motions.summary: The agency board approved an agreement with the Unified Fire Service Area to collect and pass along property tax growth from the Sweetwater #4 project area.
motions.impact: New property tax raised inside that one area goes to the agency rather than to the fire district. No tax rate is set by this, and no bill of yours changes.
